content: Each reference includes the authors, the title of the study, the journal in which it was published, the year of publication, the volume and issue numbers, and the page range. These studies cover a wide range of therapeutic approaches, including acupuncture, spinal manipulation, manual therapy, myofascial release, massage, traction, and therapeutic ultrasound, among others. The references also include randomized controlled trials, clinical trials, and systematic reviews, providing evidence for the effectiveness of these interventions in managing chronic low back pain.
